title: Diti seeks a son who could kill Indra
introduction: Diti seeks for a son to kill Indra because Indra and other gods have killed her sons in the battle after churning Milk Ocean. But Indra, being her stepson arrives at her place of asceticism, with view to destroy that Indra-killer. On a fateful day when Diti failed to maintain the procedure of vow, Indra enters her womb and dissects the foetus into seven fragments, which later become saptamarudgaNa-s, The Seven Wind-gods.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 46th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु दितिः परमदुःखिता |
मारीचं काश्यपं राम भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
hateṣu teṣu putreṣu ditiḥ parama duḥkhitā |
mārīcam kāśyapam rāma bhartāram idam abravīt
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, Lady Diti was highly anguished for those sons that are killed and said this to her husband, Sage Kashyapa, the son of Sage Maareechi." Thus Vishvamitra continued narration.

glosses.meaning: to husband, son of Mareechi, to sage Kaashyapa

verses.devanagari:
हतपुत्रास्मि भगवंस्तव पुत्रैर्महाबलैः |
शक्रहन्तारमिच्छामि पुत्रं दीर्घतपोऽर्जितम्
verses.iast:
hata putrā asmi bhagavan tava putraiḥ mahābalaiḥ |
śakra hantāram icchāmi putram dīrgha tapo arjitam
verses.translation: " 'Oh, god, I am bereaved of my sons who are killed by your great mighty sons, the sons of your second wife Aditi, as such I wish to bear a son, who is achievable by sustained penance, for he shall be the exterminator of Indra.

glosses.meaning: killed, sons, I am - my sons are killed
by sustained, penance, one who can be achievable

verses.devanagari:
साहं तपश्चरिष्यामि गर्भं मे दातुमर्हसि |
ईश्वरं शक्रहन्तारं त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
sā aham tapaḥ cariṣyāmi garbham me dātum ar.hhasi |
īśvaram śakra hantāram tvam anuGYātum ar.hhasi
verses.translation: " 'Such a bereaved mother as I am, I wish to undertake asceticism for a son who shall become an exterminator of Indra, and who shall be the ruler of worlds. As such, it will be apt of you to permit me for asceticism, and further it will be apt of you to accord me pregnancy with such a son.' Thus Diti spoke to her husband Kaashyapa.
notes: A sage's wife requires permission of her husband if she wishes to undertake an individual asceticism, because she will be receiving her own share of merit from her sage-husband's penances and practises, as he is her life-mate.

glosses.meaning: such as I am - such a bereaved mother
permission, to [to accord,] apt of you
who shall be a ruler of worlds
who shall be - Indra, exterminator of
pregnancy, to me, to accord, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मारीचः कश्यपस्तदा |
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा दितिं परमदुःखिताम्
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā mārīcaḥ kāśyapaḥ tadā |
pratyuvāca mahātejā ditim parama duḥkhitām
verses.translation: On hearing her request the great resplendent sage Kaashyapa, the son of Sage Mareechi, replied Diti, who is deeply mournful.

glosses.meaning: of her, that, sentence - request, on hearing

verses.devanagari:
एवं भवतु भद्रं ते शुचिर्भव तपोधने |
जनयिष्यसि पुत्रं त्वं शक्रहन्तारमाहवे
verses.iast:
evam bhavatu bhadram te śuciḥ bhava tapodhane |
janayiṣyasi putram tvam śakra hantāram āhave
verses.translation: " 'So be it... oh, ascetically wealthy lady, you be blest, if you abide by the propriety of the practises of asceticism, then you will be delivering a son who can become an exterminator of Indra in war.

glosses.meaning: oh, ascetically, wealthy one - Lady Diti

verses.devanagari:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शुचिर्यदि भविष्यसि |
पुत्रं त्रैलोक्यहन्तारं मत्तस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि
verses.iast:
pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu śuciḥ yadi bhaviṣyasi |
putram trailokya hantāram mattaḥ tvam janayiṣyasi
verses.translation: " 'If you can complete a thousand years of asceticism punctiliously, by my grace you can deliver a son who can be a husbander of three worlds.' Thus Sage Kaashyapa advised his wife Diti.
notes: In some other versions the word trailokya hantāram is carried forward from earlier verses of Diti, into the speech of Sage Kaashyapa also. Some have it as trailokya bhartāram 'a husbander of three worlds...' Diti may have desired for a 'killer.' But Kashyapa, as a father of both gods and demons, cannot term the issuing son as an exterminator of three worlds, because the three worlds are in vogue at Kaashyapa's grace. Some attach this adjective to Indra but not to the forthcoming son of Diti.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः पाणिना स ममार्ज ताम् |
तमालभ्य ततः स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा तपसे ययौ
verses.iast:
evam uktvā mahā tejāḥ pāṇinā sa mamārja tām |
tam ālabhya tataḥ svasti iti uktvā tapase yayau
verses.translation: "Saying thus that great resplendent sage patted her, and then on his touching her she is consecrated, and then that sage Kaashyapa departed for his ascetic practises, saying 'be blest.'

verses.devanagari:
गते तस्मिन्नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परमहर्षिता |
कुशप्लवं सामासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
gate tasmin naraśreṣṭha ditiḥ parama harṣitā |
kuśaplavam sāmāsādya tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam
verses.translation: "On the exit of Sage Kaashyapa, oh, best one among men Rama, highly elated Diti reached the sacred place called Kushaplava, on which the present City of Vishala is now standing, and practised a highly rigorous asceticism.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men, Rama
[to a sacred place called] Kushaplava, on reaching

verses.devanagari:
तपस्तस्यां हि कुर्वत्यां परिचर्यां चकार ह |
सहस्राक्षो नरश्रेष्ठ परया गुणसंपदा
verses.iast:
tapaḥ tasyām hi kurvatyām paricaryām cakāra ha |
sahasrākṣo naraśreṣṭha parayā guṇa sampadā
verses.translation: "While she is truly practising asceticism, oh, the best among men Rama, that Thousand-eyed god Indra has indeed rendered services with his abundant and surpassing veracities to her, who is none other than his maternal-aunt.

glosses.meaning: of her, asceticism, while practising, truly

verses.devanagari:
अग्निं कुशान् काष्ठमपः फलं मूलं तथैव च |
न्यवेदयत् सहस्राक्षो यच्चान्यदपि कांक्षितम्
verses.iast:
agnim kuśān kāṣṭham apaḥ phalam mūlam tathaiva ca |
nyavedayat sahasrākṣo yac ca anyat api kānkṣitam
verses.translation: "The Thousand-eyed god Indra made available fire, firewood, water, the sacred Kusha grass, fruits and like that tubers also, and whatever other items she required in her ascetic practise.

verses.devanagari:
गात्रसंवाहनैश्चैव श्रमापनयनैस्तथा |
शक्रः सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिं परिचचार ह
verses.iast:
gātra saṃvāhanaiḥ caiva śrama apanayanaiḥ tathā |
śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditim paricacāra ha
verses.translation: "All the time Indra indeed served Diti by massaging her body, and other means of removing her bodily strain resulting from her arduous practises.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु दशोने रघुनंदन |
दितिः परमसंहृष्टा सहस्राक्षमथाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
pūrṇe varṣa sahasre daśa ūne raghunandana |
ditiḥ parama saṃhṛṣṭā sahasrākṣam atha abravīt
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the descendent of Raghu, when ten years are less to complete the thousand years span of her ascetics, Diti is highly rejoiced as her ambition is going to fructify in just ten more years, and then she spoke to the Thousand-eyed god, Indra.

glosses.meaning: ten, less - less than ten years - 999 years
to Thousand-eyed god, Indra, spoke to.

verses.devanagari:
तपश्चरन्त्या वर्षाणि दश वीर्यवतां वर |
अवशिष्टानि भद्रं ते भ्रातरं द्रक्ष्यसे ततः
verses.iast:
tapaḥ carantyā var.hṣāṇi daśa vīryavatām vara |
avaśiṣṭāni bhadram te bhrātaram drakṣyase tataḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, best one among the valiant ones, Indra, to me who am practising asceticism ten years are remaining to complete, then you can see your brother, you be safe.

glosses.meaning: oh, among valiant ones, best one - oh, Indra
asceticism, to me who am practising

verses.devanagari:
यमहं त्वत्कृते पुत्र तमाधास्ये जयोत्सुकम् |
त्रैलोक्यविजयं पुत्र सह भोक्ष्यसि विज्वरः
verses.iast:
yam aham tvat kṛte putra tam ādhāsye jaya utsukam |
trailokya vijayam putra saha bhokṣyasi vijvaraḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, son Indra, whom I am bringing up for your reason, I will bring him up as a victory-enthusiast, and oh, son, Indra, along with him conquering the three worlds you can enjoy them, without febrility from your enemies.

glosses.meaning: in victory [to conquer you,] enthusiastic one

verses.devanagari:
याचितेन सुरश्रेष्ट पित्रा तव महात्मना |
वरो वर्षसहस्रान्ते मम दत्तः सुतं प्रति
verses.iast:
yācitena suraśreṣṭa pitrā tava māhātmanā |
varo varṣa sasra ante mama dattaḥ sutam prati
verses.translation: "Oh, best one among gods, Indra, on my prayer your high-souled father Sage Kaashyapa bestowed this boon on me for a son, which materialises at the end of thousand years, and only ten more years are to slip by.

glosses.meaning: from high-souled one, by your, father- Kaashyapa
years, thousand, at the end of
to me, son, towards [for a son]

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा च दितिस्तत्र प्राप्ते मध्यन्दिनेश्वरे |
निद्रयापहृता देवी पादौ कृत्वाथ शीर्षतः
verses.iast:
iti uktvā ca ditiḥ tatra prāpte madhyandina īśvare |
nidrayā pahṛtā devī pādau kṛtvātha śīrṣataḥ
verses.translation: "When Diti was saying thus, the noontime sun was reigning high that lady is stolen over by sleep keeping her feet headward.
notes: This 'keeping feet headward' is variously inferred. While sitting she leaned on her knees and her braid touched feet, thus she became impious. She slept with her head neither towards east nor to south. The ancient cots in India used to have head-side and feet-side finishing. Then she placed head at feet-side and feet at head-side. Even if a cot is not there, though slept on ground, the head shall be positioned eastward or southward, but not to north or west. Finally, she slept at noontime, and for a person under a vow noontime sleep is prohibitive. anena vratasthānām divā svāpaḥ pāda sthāne śiraḥ sthāpanam ca aśucikaram iti sūcitam - dk Hence her meticulousness is defeated.

glosses.meaning: [sky,] in middle, on reaching - at midday
there in that matter of asceticism

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा तामशुचिं शक्रः पादयोः कृतमूर्धजाम् |
शिरःस्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā tām aśucim śakraḥ pādayoḥ kṛta mūrdhajām |
śiraḥ sthāne kṛtau pādau jahāsa ca mumoda ca
verses.translation: "On observing her who has become impious by placing her head at feet-side and braid falling on feet, Indra is gladdened and laughed at her failed asceticism.

glosses.meaning: from head, emerging ones - head-hair, braid - braid resting on feet
head, at the place of, placed, feet

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः शरीरविवरं प्रविवेश पुरंदरः |
गर्भं च सप्तधा राम चिच्छेद परमात्मवान्
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ śarīra vivaram praviveśa purandaraḥ |
garbham ca saptadhā rāma ciccheda parama ātmavān
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, , being a highly courageous one, Indra the destroyer of enemy fastnesses, entered the body of Diti through her vaginal aperture and rent her foetus asunder into seven fragments.

glosses.meaning: womb [foetus,] into seven ways [seven fragments,] rent asunder.

verses.devanagari:
भिद्यमानस्ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा |
रुरोद सुस्वरं राम ततो दितिरबुध्यत
verses.iast:
bhidyamānaḥ tato garbho vajreṇa śata parvaṇā |
ruroda susvaram rāma tato ditiḥ abudhyata
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, then that foetus wailed clamorously while being sliced with Thunderbolt that has hundred cutting edges, and then Diti woke up.

verses.devanagari:
मा रुदो मा रुदश्चेति गर्भं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत |
बिभेद च महातेजा रुदन्तमपि वासवः
verses.iast:
mā rudo mā rudaḥ ca iti garbham śakro abhyabhāṣata |
bibheda ca mahātejā rudantam api vāsavaḥ
verses.translation: " 'Do not scream, do not scream...' thus Indra was coaxing the foetus, and even though that foetus is screaming piteously the great resplendent Indra has gone on fragmenting it.

glosses.meaning: do not, scream, do not, scream
thus, Indra, to foetus, said - coaxed

verses.devanagari:
न हन्तव्यं न हन्तव्यमित्येवं दितिरब्रवीत् |
निष्पपात ततः शक्रो मातुर्वचनगौरवात्
verses.iast:
na hantavyam na hantavyam iti evam ditiḥ abravīt |
niṣpapāta tataḥ śakro mātur vacana gauravāt
verses.translation: " 'Unkillable, unkillable is my foetus...' thus Diti raved in that way, and then Indra fell out of the womb honouring his stepmother's entreaty.

glosses.meaning: on [step] mother's, words [entreaty,] owing honour to
out, fallen - fell out of womb.

verses.devanagari:
प्रांजलिर्वज्रसहितो दितिं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत |
अशुचिर्देवि सुप्तासि पादयोः कृतमूर्धजा
verses.iast:
prāñjaliḥ vajra sahito ditim śakro abhyabhāṣata |
aśuciḥ devi suptā asi pādayoḥ kṛta mūrdhajā
verses.translation: "Indra humbly folding his palms that are still handling his bloody Thunderbolt spoke to Diti, 'oh, lady, you have become impious when your braid touched your feet and when you have gone to sleep in midday, and you vow is thwarted.'

glosses.meaning: Thunderbolt, along with - blood-wet weapon still in hand

verses.devanagari:
तदन्तरमहं लब्ध्वा शक्रहन्तारमाहवे |
अभिदं सप्तधा देवि तन्मे त्वम् क्षन्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
tat antaram aham labdhvā śakra hantāram āhave |
abhindam saptadhā devi tan me tvam kṣantum ar.hhasi || 1-46-23(E)
verses.translation: "Thereby I gained a chance to eliminate him who can eliminate Indra in a battle. Hence I fragmented your foetus into seven fragments, and it will be apt of you to pardon me for that act of mine.' " So said Indra to lady Diti. Thus, Sage Vishvamitra continued narration about City of Vishaala.

glosses.meaning: in battle, Indra, [who can become] eliminator
in seven ways [seven fragments,] fragmented - the foetus
you, to pardon, apt of you.
